title: Git
description: Can land, share and recover work from the working tree through Git's commit graph — and can choose merge versus rebase without rewriting history others already have.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can stage changes from the working tree, create a feature branch, record at least two commits whose messages state what changed and why, and open a pull request a reviewer can act on — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can complete a conflicted merge so both sides' intended content survive, rebase a messy local branch into a readable history, and show the pre-rebase state is still recoverable.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently keep a shared branch reviewable — choose merge or rebase for the situation, push without rewriting history others already have, and answer each review comment with a follow-up commit or a written no-change reason.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a regression with git bisect and an automated check, name the first bad commit and the causal change, and recover from a rewritten or detached HEAD without losing work.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's branch for rewritten shared history, unrecoverable rebases or unreadable commits, and teach when to rebase versus merge on a repository they did not set up.
